scope: Calibrates the opposite-provider TEXT review workflow (prompt, model, effort, output schema, CLI flags) on synthetic Task-shaped cases with hidden, source-verified labels. It is not evidence that the course corpus is correct, not a human review, and not a learning-effectiveness or CEFR result. Audio calibration (20 files) is out of scope for this brief.

A.description: Claude-authored -> OpenAI reviewer (codex exec, gpt-6.1-sol, xhigh)
A.result: PASS after 2 repair cycles, with prompt v3 (gate: held-out H2, every threshold met). Main set failed on the unintended тильда defect (v1); cycle 1 failed on 3 unsupported valid-control rejections (v2).

B.description: packet -> fresh Claude reviewer (claude -p, claude-opus-5-5, medium, no tools, no advisor)
B.result: PASS after 1 repair cycle, with prompt v2 (gate: held-out H1, every threshold met). With prompt v3 on held-out H2 it recognised 2/3 ambiguous cases (the miss was blocked, not released); its ambiguity recognition is therefore not shown to be reliably >= 90% at medium effort. Direction B here is same-provider (Claude-authored packet), so it calibrates Opus as a reviewer, not the Sol-authored -> Opus production route.

recommendedSettings.bulkReviewRoute: Authoring workers are Claude (work/briefs/09-authoring.md) -> opposite-provider review is direction A.

directionB.status: validated with prompt v2 (repair cycle 1, held-out H1); v3 not fully validated for B (H2 ambiguity 2/3, no release-blocking miss)
directionB.command: claude -p --model opus --effort medium --tools "" --safe-mode --setting-sources project,local --no-session-persistence --output-format json --json-schema "$(cat review-output.schema.json)" < prompt.txt   (run inside a directory containing only packet.json)
directionB.mustHave: --setting-sources project,local: without it the user-level advisorModel (Fable) is consulted even with --tools "" --safe-mode (run B-main)

packetRequirements: One case per task: context {lessonId, lessonTopic, taughtBefore = the prerequisites mapped for the task (assessed targets' earlier steps and every form, construction and new word the task depends on), targets}, clips (transcript + translationUk) for listening tasks, and the complete Task JSON.
No author reasoning, confidence or 'already correct' claims; no labels.
Learner-facing Ukrainian follows content/README.md rule 6a (знак наголосу / графічний наголос; тильда only for ~).
verdictHandling: flawed + blocking yes -> author repair, new hash, fresh review of the changed items.
uncertain -> escalation per CONTENT-PLAN (fresh opposite-provider review at xhigh with exact source passages) or quarantine; never a unique key.
A flawed verdict whose defect text says the context does not settle the reading should be routed like uncertain (escalation), not as an author error: Opus did this on cal-28 and cal-h2-05.
Reviewer citations are mostly '(from memory)'; treat them as leads to verify, not as evidence.
recommendedSettings.recalibrateWhen: the model id, the CLI major version, the reviewer prompt or the output schema changes.

limitations: Calibrates a workflow on synthetic cases; it does not establish corpus correctness, linguistic certification, learning effectiveness or CEFR level. No human reviewer took part.
The cases, labels and adjudications were written by one Claude agent (Opus 5.5); adjudication is not independent. Every decision is recorded with its reason in adjudication*.json.
Direction B is same-provider (Claude reviews Claude-authored cases): it calibrates Opus as a reviewer, not the Sol-authored -> Opus route of the production matrix.

RAE/ASALE and Instituto Cervantes pages could not be retrieved (rae.es and dle.rae.es: HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge; cvc.cervantes.es: HTTP 404 for every path including the root; Internet Archive refused rae.es and then rate-limited). Labels were verified against FundéuRAE (advised by the RAE), the Словник української мови via slovnyk.ua, and repository contracts. Four main-set flawed labels rest only on project contracts (cal-14, cal-19, cal-29, cal-30). Registry sources S1-S6 and S9 (CVC) were not retrievable at verification time.
Held-out sets are small (12 cases): the thresholds 5/5 and 3/3 are coarse, each configuration ran once, and run-to-run variance is not measured (B passed H1 but missed 1/3 ambiguous cases on H2).
Efforts were not varied (Opus xhigh and Sol high untested); the least costly passing configuration (CONTENT-PLAN) is not established.
Codex loads the user's global ~/.codex/AGENTS.md even with --ignore-user-config (a probe without an English instruction answered in Ukrainian); the prompt enforces English output.

Unintended authoring defects in the calibration packets are documented rather than hidden: «тильда» (8 main cases), quedar listed from a later lesson (cal-04), condujo context without strong endings (cal-18), the coordinated-antecedent confound (cal-28), «Todavía» also fitting cal-h2-01, «llegamos» present/preterite (cal-h2-06), sparse taughtBefore lists in H1.
